name: Pololu Romi · 2WD chassis

catalog.designation: Romi Chassis Kit #3500 · source assembly with optional front caster

geometryEvidence.summary: Original source surfaces and factory placements; 5 retained valid source solids in 5 CAD components. Preview chord tolerance 0.05 mm.
geometryEvidence.limitations: The factory CAD is supplied as five shapes: chassis, battery cover, two wheels and a front caster. geometryEvidence.limitations: The manufacturer-linked ROB0003 STEP is a 2015 SolidWorks AP203 source revision. Measured CAD dimensions are retained; they are not stretched to the current product listing (200 × 170 × 105 mm). Confirm the actual purchased revision, because the older assembly manual also has different dimensions. This source CAD omits the four gearmotors and battery holder present in the retail kit; no substitute motor boxes are invented.
